request.title: Request
request.isPeakHelp: Turn on for Fri–Sun, holidays, and busy lunch/dinner windows (11:30–13:30 / 18:00–20:30) when lines are long. It helps secure a worker faster. You can also toggle the peak surcharge on or off after the request is created, as long as it has not been paid yet — open the request detail screen.
request.togglePeakAfterHelp: Until payment is made, you can switch the peak surcharge on or off even after the request is created.
request.notesPlaceholder:
e.g.
- Party of 2 adults + 1 child. Please call me when our turn is close.
- Counter seat preferred, table seat is fine if not available.
- We plan to arrive around 12:30. I'll message if we're running late.
- Could you check with the staff about allergy-friendly options?
